[EN] Controlling the mines means nothing if we can't get shipments in and out of here.

The {@LinkCreature:4#1031#sooty sporewalkers} and the {@LinkCreature:4#1032#smoldering ghilliedhus} are mindless beasts, but that doesn't matter when it's your ore-wagon they're tearing apart.

Keep them away from the roads, would you?
[ES] Controlar las minas no sirve de nada si no podemos hacer entrar y salir envíos de aquí.

Los {@LinkCreature:4#1031#sooty sporewalkers} y los {@LinkCreature:4#1032#smoldering ghilliedhus} son bestias sin mente, pero eso no importa cuando están destrozando tu carreta de mineral.

Mantenlos alejados de los caminos, ¿quieres?

[EN] With those beasts out of the way, maybe we can get supply trains in and out of here.
[ES] Con esas bestias fuera del camino, tal vez podamos lograr que los trenes de suministro entren y salgan de aquí.
